changeSet.author: local-chinese-edition
changeSet.comment: Keep a fresh China installation usable: seed one editable local facility only when no active referring facility has been configured. Existing hospital master data is never changed.
changeSet.sql: WITH inserted_parent AS ( INSERT INTO clinlims.organization (id, name, code, is_active, mls_sentinel_lab_flag, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.organization_seq'), '本院', 'CN-LOCAL', 'Y', 'N', now() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.organization o JOIN clinlims.organization_organization_type oot ON oot.org_id = o.id JOIN clinlims.organization_type ot ON ot.id = oot.org_type_id WHERE o.is_active = 'Y' AND ot.short_name = 'referring clinic' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.organization WHERE code = 'CN-LOCAL' ) RETURNING id ), mapped_parent AS ( INSERT INTO clinlims.organization_organization_type (org_id, org_type_id) SELECT parent.id, type.id FROM inserted_parent parent JOIN clinlims.organization_type type ON type.short_name = 'referring clinic' RETURNING org_id ), inserted_children AS ( INSERT INTO clinlims.organization (id, name, code, org_id, is_active, mls_sentinel_lab_flag, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.organization_seq'), seed.name, seed.code, parent.id, 'Y', 'N', now() FROM inserted_parent parent CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('门诊', 'CN-OPD'), ('急诊', 'CN-ED'), ('住院病区', 'CN-IPD'), ('体检中心', 'CN-PE') ) AS seed(name, code) RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO clinlims.organization_organization_type (org_id, org_type_id) SELECT child.id, department_type.id FROM inserted_children child JOIN clinlims.organization_type department_type ON department_type.short_name = 'dept' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mapped_parent);
